model.name: Return / Refund
model.purpose: Represent a governed return and refund case so agents can distinguish request, eligibility, authorization, reverse movement, inspection, disposition, financial obligation and refund execution without confusing the case with order, fulfilment, shipment, invoice, payment, warranty, recall or dispute masters.
model.scope_statement: Owns case identity, versions, profiles and state; trigger, reason and evidence; order, fulfilment, entitlement and payment bindings; claimant, merchant, seller, provider, payer, refund recipient, carrier and authority roles; rule version, jurisdiction, window, conditions, exclusions and eligibility assertions; requested remedies, alternatives, authorization and instructions; subject, quantity, lot, serial, component, condition and digital-access observations; reverse movement, custody, handover and receipt evidence; inspection, acceptance and disposition assertions; refund basis, taxes, fees, discounts, deductions, allocation, currency and rounding inputs; credit, refund obligation, instruction, execution, settlement and notification references; failures, duplicates, fraud signals, chargeback, appeals, disputes, reconciliation and closure assertions; distinct clocks, provenance, privacy, retention, validation and loss-aware projections. External commerce, logistics, inventory, financial, legal and records masters remain authoritative.
in_scope: Case identity, trigger, source-transaction and party bindings, eligibility, remedy request, decision, authorization, subject, quantity, condition, reverse movement, receipt and inspection evidence
Disposition, financial calculation, refund obligation and execution references, exceptions, reconciliation, closure, clocks, provenance, access, retention and projections
out_of_scope: Owning Order, Contract, Fulfilment, Party, Product, Service, Inventory, Shipment, Package, Location, Entitlement, Invoice, Credit Note, Payment, Account, Warranty, Recall, Dispute, Adjudication, Waste or Records masters

Treating item return, authorization, receipt, inspection, credit adjustment, payment instruction, execution, settlement or closure as universal proof of refund entitlement, customer receipt or legal finality
Autonomous legal eligibility, return authorization, custody transfer, condition judgment, disposition, credit issuance, payment execution, disclosure or record destruction

boundary_notes.distinction: The unified registry supplies only a provisional parent signal. Fulfilment owns forward obligation-performance evidence; this model owns the requested or required reverse case and remedy evidence without a settled containment edge.

boundary_notes.neighbor: Order, item, shipment, inventory, entitlement, invoice and payment
boundary_notes.distinction: These systems own commercial commitments, object identity, movement execution, stock, access, accounting documents and funds. This model stores typed references and subject-specific assertions.

boundary_notes.neighbor: Warranty, product recall, chargeback, complaint, dispute and adjudication
boundary_notes.distinction: These lifecycles can trigger or challenge a remedy but remain external; return/refund evidence does not decide their authority or final state.

boundary_notes.neighbor: UBL, UN/EDIFACT, ISO 20022, EU law, IFRS, EPCIS, CBV, Schema.org, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI
boundary_notes.distinction: Each representation has a distinct scope; every mapping is version-pinned, profile-qualified and loss-declaring.

sources.title: Universal Business Language Version 2.3
sources.relevance: Defines Order Cancellation and Credit Note business documents, parties, lines, quantities, allowances, charges, taxes and references.

sources.title: UN/EDIFACT Announcement for returns message
sources.organization: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe
sources.relevance: Defines announcements of goods returns, reasons, item identity, quantities, condition, transport, requested disposition, cost responsibility and requested documents.

sources.title: UN/EDIFACT Instruction for returns message
sources.organization: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe
sources.relevance: Defines acceptance or refusal and instructions for return, repair, destruction or other disposition of goods.

sources.title: ISO 20022 Message Definitions: PaymentReturnV15
sources.relevance: Defines the current inter-agent PaymentReturn message while commercial refund entitlement and customer communication remain separate.

sources.title: Directive 2011/83/EU on consumer rights
sources.relevance: Defines scoped withdrawal notice, return duties, reimbursement timing, original payment means, delivery-cost limits and evidence-of-dispatch dependency.

sources.title: Directive EU 2019/771 on contracts for the sale of goods
sources.relevance: Defines scoped conformity remedies, repair, replacement, price reduction, termination, return and reimbursement of consumer goods.

sources.title: Directive EU 2019/770 on digital content and digital services
sources.relevance: Defines scoped digital termination, proportionate reimbursement, same payment means, content retrieval and access disabling duties.

sources.title: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers
sources.version_or_date: 2023 issued standard, paragraphs B20 to B27
sources.relevance: Defines accounting for sales with a right of return, refund liabilities and recovery assets without determining individual legal eligibility.

sources.title: EPCIS Standard 2.0.1
sources.relevance: Defines interoperable event capture and query for object, quantity, aggregation, transaction and association observations with event and record times.

sources.title: Core Business Vocabulary 2.0
sources.relevance: Defines return-related business steps and dispositions including returned, recalled, non-conformant, disposed and destroyed.

sources.title: MerchantReturnPolicy
sources.relevance: Defines public discovery fields for applicable country, window, method, label, fees, conditions, seasonal override and refund type.

sources.title: International Sale of Goods CISG and related transactions
sources.organization: United Nations Commission on International Trade Law
sources.version_or_date: CISG adopted 11 April 1980; portal accessed 6 September 2026
sources.relevance: Defines scoped conformity, examination, notice and buyer or seller remedies for international sales.

sources.title: Regulation EU 2023/988 on general product safety
sources.version_or_date: Regulation 10 May 2023; current consolidated context checked 2026
sources.relevance: Defines scoped product-safety recall notices and effective, cost-free and timely repair, replacement or refund remedies.

sources.title: Date and Time on the Internet: Timestamps
sources.relevance: Defines interoperable timestamps with seconds and an explicit UTC relationship.

sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
sources.relevance: Defines entities, activities, agents, attribution, generation, derivation and revision provenance.

sources.title: Data on the Web Best Practices: Data Quality Vocabulary
sources.relevance: Defines quality dimensions, measurements, annotations, policies and certificates.

sources.title: ODRL Information Model 2.2
sources.relevance: Defines permissions, prohibitions, duties, constraints, assets and parties for policy projections.

sources.title: OpenAPI Specification 3.1.1
sources.relevance: Defines HTTP API operations, schemas, responses, security and reusable components for service projections.

compatibility_rules: Ignore additive fields only when identity, version, policy, parties, subject, quantities, states, amounts, times, authority, access and provenance survive.
Every projection pins specification version and declares loss in policy, subject, quantity, condition, state, timing, amount, authority and evidence semantics.

identity_priority: Authoritative master-system identifier for return/refund case, version, request, authorization, subject line, movement, receipt, inspection, disposition, adjustment, refund or artifact, qualified by namespace and kind.
Governed globally resolvable case or artifact IRI.
Dimension UUID or ULID when neither preceding identifier exists.
artifact_rules.timestamp_rule: Use RFC 3339 timestamps with seconds and explicit offset or Z; distinguish purchase, fulfilment, discovery, request, authorization, label issue, handover, receipt, inspection, decision, refund due, instruction, execution, settlement, notification, observation, ingestion and knowledge times whenever they differ.
artifact_rules.integrity_rule: Store digest, media type, record kind, case and version IDs, profile, source transaction, subject, actor, quantity and unit, amount and currency, event and knowledge times, confidentiality and provenance.

policies: The model owns return/refund case context but not order, fulfilment, item, shipment, inventory, entitlement, invoice, payment, warranty, recall, dispute or records masters.
Request, eligibility, authorization, handover, receipt, inspection, disposition, refund obligation, instruction, execution, settlement, customer receipt and closure states and clocks remain distinct.
Returned, accepted, credited, instructed, executed, settled or closed status never alone proves legal entitlement, customer receipt, ledger finality or dispute closure.

Agents cannot autonomously determine legal eligibility, authorize a return, transfer custody, judge condition, choose physical disposition, issue credit, instruct or execute payment, disclose or destroy records without delegated authority.

read: Resolve case head, source transaction, parties, subject, policy, eligibility, authorization, movement, receipt, inspection, disposition, calculation, refund evidence, exceptions, access and projection loss.
create: Bind identity, owner, purpose, profile, source transaction, claimant, subject, reason, evidence, rule version, source authority and initial state before assertions are accepted.
update: Append successor eligibility, authorization, movement, receipt, inspection, disposition, calculation, refund, exception, reconciliation and correction assertions with reason, authority, event time and knowledge time.
delete: Apply legal hold, commercial, consumer, safety, financial, privacy and Dimension retention policy; tombstone only the catalogue view without cascading to external masters, and let authoritative systems execute financial or physical disposition.

responsibilities: Own order bindings, policy versions, eligibility inputs, remedy terms, price and adjustment references.

responsibilities: Own authorization, return instructions, reverse movement, custody and receipt bindings.

roles.name: Inspection and disposition authority
responsibilities: Own inspection criteria, condition evidence, acceptance and disposition decisions.

roles.name: Finance and payment steward
responsibilities: Own credit, refund obligation, payment instruction, execution, settlement and reconciliation references.

roles.name: Legal, privacy and safety authority
responsibilities: Own jurisdiction, disputes, protected commerce data, product safety, access and retention limitations.

roles.name: Interoperability and records steward
responsibilities: Own mappings, conformance evidence, declared loss, legal hold and disposition policy.

access.default_rule: Deny party, address, account, payment, item, serial, condition, fraud, dispute, evidence and security-sensitive data unless purpose-bound policy permits the minimum necessary view.
exceptions: Declared operational, safety, legal, audit, regulatory, consumer-rights or subject-rights access must cite authority, scope, purpose and time limit and be logged.
audit_requirements: Log actor, agent, role, purpose, case and version, operation, authority, policy, RFC 3339 time, affected subject, quantity or amount, source revision and outcome without duplicating restricted data.

read_order: Read Dimension namespace, commerce, return, payment, safety, privacy, retention and agent policies.
Read this model and linked order, fulfilment, party, product, shipment, inventory, entitlement, invoice, payment, warranty, recall, dispute and records models before mutation.

coverage.claim: WM-ECO-025 covers one governed return/refund case from trigger and eligibility through authorization, reverse movement or access effect, receipt, inspection, disposition, refund calculation, execution evidence, exceptions, reconciliation, closure, governance and loss-aware projections. Relation, jurisdiction, sector, payment-scheme, conformance and independent-review questions remain deferred.

known_omissions: Claude and Grok each timed out on one bounded attempt; no independent external result was admitted.
WM-ECO-024 is only a provisional parent signal and the frozen candidate relation ledger contains no settled WM-ECO-025 edge.
Consumer, business, marketplace, subscription, travel, financial, healthcare, food, hazardous-goods and cross-border returns need separate profiles.
National contract, tax, accounting, product-safety, privacy, signature, payment-scheme, chargeback and records rules require jurisdiction or scheme review.
UNECE and IFRS source pages had direct-access limitations, and every UBL, EDIFACT, ISO 20022, EU, IFRS, EPCIS and Schema.org mapping needs release-pinned conformance tests.
conflicts: Return request, entitlement, authorization, reverse shipment, receipt, inspection, disposition, refund obligation, credit note, payment return or reversal, chargeback and dispute are related but not interchangeable.
Item return does not imply refund, refund can occur without item return, credit does not prove payment, and payment return does not determine the commercial obligation.
Requested, promised, effective, event, observation, ingestion and knowledge times must not be collapsed.
Merchant policy, contract, statute, safety recall and goodwill may yield competing remedies and must coexist with authority and precedence evidence.
regional_assumptions: Eligibility, windows, evidence, cost allocation, deductions, tax treatment, refund means, deadlines and remedies depend on governing law, party type, contract, channel, sector and payment scheme.
CISG and EU consumer, digital and product-safety rules are scoped profiles, not universal governing law; IFRS is accounting evidence, not legal entitlement.
adversarial_checks: Reject a case that collapses into order, fulfilment, shipment, inventory, invoice, payment, warranty, recall, dispute or records masters.
Reject request as entitlement, authorization as custody, return receipt as acceptance, credit note as refund payment, execution as settlement, or closure as dispute finality.
Reject quantity, condition or amount without subject identity, unit or currency, method, source, event time, uncertainty and reconciliation state.
Reject correction, cancellation or reopening that erases prior decisions, custody, inspections, adjustments or payment evidence.
Reject autonomous legal eligibility, authorization, custody, disposition, accounting, payment, disclosure or destruction without delegated authority.
Reject a projection that hides policy, subject, quantity, condition, state axis, amount, time, authority, provenance or information loss.
